text.body:
Abhidhānottaratantra ch. 19 [Tib. & Ś. 22]
= Lokesh Chandra facsimile ed.
= 1138 AD palm-leaf codex
[ 89 beginning of folio]
athāsyaivaṃ bhāvanām vakṣye sarvvasattvahitodaye |
jhaṭitākāram ātmānaṃ devī pratyaṅgirākramaṃ |
caturvaktraṃ ṣoḍaṣabhujaṃ ālīḍhapadam ākramaṃ |
duṣṭā nānāvidhān vighnā adhaḥ patati paṅkajāṃ |
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ sitanīlāruṇāpītorvānanā |
bhūṣitāṃ sarvālaṅkārasampūrṇāṃ |
sitavastropaśobhitāṃ |
pañcabuddhamakuṭāṃ mṛtasaṃjivanī parā [|]
trinetrāṃ śāntavadanāṃ anye raudrakarālinaḥ |
vajrollālanatarjanyā ghaṇṭāpāśaparāparā (!)|
kuliśāsiśūlaparaśukapāla aṅkuśaṃ tathā |
cāpakhaṭvāṅgadharā parā pūritakarṇayoḥ [|]
mudgaraṃ cakram abhayaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyikāṃ [|]
atha vā aṣṭavaktraṃ ca vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ |
dakṣiṇe nīlaraktaṃ pītaṃ raudraṃ hāhasitānanaṃ |
vāmaharitaraktaṃ ca dhūmākāra[ṃ] tathaiva ca |
ūrdhva[ṃ] śānta[ṃ] suśubhraṃ [ca] candragauraṃ ca dehajā |
asyaiva hṛdaye cakraṃ candramaṇḍalamadhyagaṃ |
mṛtasaṃjīvaṃnaṃ mantraṃ japed bhaktyā s[am]āhitaḥ |
oṃ amṛtasaṃjīvani + + + + + kh+ [= mahāmṛtamukhi] jīvaṃ praveśaya 2 sarvavajrapadma((samā))yoge mahābodhicittaviṭapita(?)mūrte hūṃ 2 a ā aṃ aḥ svāhā || [ 89]
anena tu jāpena mṛta[ṃ] saṃjīvati sarvathā |
akālamṛtyuṃ śamayati mṛta[ṃ] vyutthāpayed dhruvaṃ |
atha tāḥ sa[ṃ]tuṣṭā yoginyaḥ paramādbhutāḥ pranartayan pratikurvantyo hīḥhāḥkāreṇa gādayaṃ hāhākāreṇa saṃtuṣṭā
[...]
haihaikāreṇa saṃtrāśinyo hūṃhūṃkāreṇa pūrayan
hūṃ 2 kāreṇa ālambyaṃ phaṭ 2 kāreṇa māraṇaṃ hūṃ 2 kāreṇa kīlayantya jaḥjaḥkāreṇākaḍhḍhayaṃ saḥsakāreṇa satkurvaṃ sādhu niścaraṇaṃ suśvaraṃ (!) hūṃbhrūṃkāreṇa māramantyaḥ (!)
[...]
[...]
[...]
[...]
[...]
[...] hūṃkāreṇa jabhinyaḥ
hoḥkāreṇānurāginyaḥ haṃhaṃkāreṇa rakṣantyaḥ phuḥ 2 kāreṇa toṣantyaḥ ḍāṃkāreṇa pūṣiṇyaḥ ghraṃṭhakāreṇa puṣpinyaḥ
gaṃ 2 kāreṇa gandhinyaḥ raṃ 2 kāreṇa rajinya iti ||
yathākrameṇa śāntikādikrameṇā (!) eva[ṃ]vidhinānuṣṭheyaṃ || ||
ity Abhidhānottarottare mṛtasaṃjīvanī sarvakarmakarī nāma bhāvanāpaṭala ūnaviṃśatimaḥ || ||
[ 897']
